content: **Pre-flight (architect).** Ship deploy/{docker-compose.yaml, Caddyfile.example, .env.example, helm/{Chart.yaml,values.yaml.example,templates/...}, systemd/polaris.service, Dockerfile.bluesky-profile} + docs/ops/backup.md.
